claims.text: The Legislative Assembly states that nominations for Prime Minister Designate closed at 4:30pm on Thursday 14th December 2017 with two received: the first on Tuesday 5th December 2017 from Hon. Pohiva Tu'i'onetoa, and the second on Thursday 14th December 2017 from Hon. Samiu Kuita Vaipulu.
claims.uncertainty: The names are those of the members who lodged the nominations, not the candidates. The candidates were to be revealed at the meeting.
